deliveredDate.title: Delivered Date
deliveredDate.description: The date the order was delivered. Blank if not yet delivered or not found.

found.title: Found
found.description: True if a matching order was found, false otherwise.

message.title: Message
message.description: A short human-readable explanation, especially when the order was not found.

orderDate.title: Order Date
orderDate.description: The date the order was placed. Blank if not found.

orderNumber.title: Order Number
orderNumber.description: The order number of the matched order. Blank if not found.

status.title: Status
status.description: The order status: Pending, Shipped, Delivered or Cancelled. Blank if not found.

totalAmount.title: Total Amount
totalAmount.description: The order total. Blank if not found.
